svg.text: Fictitious e-commerce, 3 years of operations: orders, GA4 tracking, Meta, Google and TikTok Ads,
attribution and regional MMM. 44 tables in 7 areas. 100% synthetic data.
Each area has its own diagram (1 to 6). The lines show which keys link the areas.
Labels: keys that link the areas. Dashed line: logical link (no physical FK) or reconciliation of totals. Details in diagrams 1 to 6.
Product, SKU (variant), price history (SCD2), stock balance and daily stock closing.
6. Regional MMM, geo tests and other channels
Media from every platform by day × channel × state; geo-lift; TikTok, affiliates and CRM. Dashed lines: logical link, no physical FK.
Customer registration, orders with items, payment attempts, shipping, returns and reviews.
Ad click → session → GA4 events (server-side GTM) → sends to Meta CAPI / Google; credit per touchpoint.
Account → campaign → ad set → ad, with daily insights per ad (as the Marketing API exports them).
Account → campaign (Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen) → ad group/asset group → keyword, with daily metrics.
